ukmt-pink-2022-07.prompt: Five squares and two right-angled triangles are positioned as shown. The areas of three squares are $3\ \mathrm{m}^2$, $7\ \mathrm{m}^2$ and $22\ \mathrm{m}^2$ as shown. What is the area, in $\mathrm{m}^2$, of the square with the question mark?

ukmt-pink-2022-11.prompt: Gran's first grandchild guessed that Gran was 75, the second 78 and the third 81. It turned out that one of them was mistaken by 1 year, another one by 2 years and the other by 4 years. What is Gran's age?

ukmt-pink-2022-20.prompt: Cuthbert is going to make a cube with each face divided into four squares. Each square must have one shape drawn on it; either a cross, a triangle or a circle. Squares that share an edge must have different shapes on them. One possible cube is shown in the diagram. Which of the following combinations of crosses and triangles is possible on such a cube (with the other shapes being circles)?

ukmt-pink-2022-22.prompt: The bases of the two touching squares shown lie on the same straight line. The lengths of the diagonals of the larger square and the smaller square are 10 cm and 8 cm respectively. $P$ is the centre of the smaller square. What is the area, in $\mathrm{cm}^2$, of the shaded triangle $PQR$?
